svg.title: Magnetic Flux
svg.desc: Diagram for computing magnetic coupling: a straight source wire carrying current I1(t) produces circular magnetic field lines B = mu0 I1 / (2 pi r). Beside it is a rectangular victim loop of height l spanning distances r1 to r2 from the wire; the flux through the loop is the integral of B over area elements dA = dr dz. Marius-Juston 2026
